drhp.business: YAAP Digital Limited is a digital-first media and marketing solutions company providing integrated services to brands and businesses, with offerings spanning digital marketing, creative and content solutions, influencer marketing, performance marketing, media solutions, technology-enabled marketing services and UI/UX. The Company combines creativity, technology, data and consumer insights to develop integrated marketing solutions for clients across sectors including financial services, consumer goods, tourism, automotive, technology, healthcare and government-related projects.
drhp.expansion: YAAP's principal expansion during FY 2025-26 was the acquisition of Gozoop Online Private Limited, structured in tranches with the Company intending to acquire 100% of Gozoop's shareholding by completion of the third tranche; consideration is linked to Gozoop's normalised EBITDA and combines cash and share swap. Gozoop adds capabilities in creative services, community management, online reputation management and digital marketing. risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Company-disclosed key risk in MD&A risk management section.
- Availability of alternative digital marketing service providers, in-house marketing teams and technology-driven solutions may increase competitive intensity.
- Changes in digital advertising platforms and algorithms, and rapid technology shifts, may affect operations.
- The digital marketing industry is highly talent-driven; the Company remains exposed to the risk of attracting and retaining specialised talent.
- Flagged explicitly as a key risk area in MD&A risk management.
- Relevant given the ongoing tranche-based acquisition and integration of Gozoop Online Private Limited.
- Company operates across India, the UAE and Singapore, and discloses earnings/expenditure in foreign currency.
- Client advertising and marketing spend is sensitive to broader economic conditions, per MD&A risk management.
